fields.discharge_instructions: Keep the wound dressings dry for 5 days. No heavy lifting or strenuous exercise for 2 weeks. Soft diet for 3 days, then return to normal diet. Seek care if the wound becomes red or swollen or if fever develops.

course: Presented with 18 hours of periumbilical pain migrating to the right iliac fossa, with nausea and low-grade fever. Ultrasound was consistent with acute appendicitis.
Laparoscopic appendectomy was performed on the day of admission without complication. Oral intake was resumed on post-operative day 1 and the patient was mobilising independently before discharge.
discharge_meds: Paracetamol 500 mg, 2 tablets every 6 hours as needed for pain
Ibuprofen 400 mg, 1 tablet three times daily after meals for 3 days
extra.follow_up: Surgical outpatient clinic in 7 days for wound check and suture removal.
